hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Identify tweets that exceed length limits or contain excessive mentions or topic tags.

hints.title: Pattern Counts
hints.text: Count occurrences of the at symbol and hash symbol by comparing the original length with the length after removing the character.

hints.title: Filter Criteria
hints.text: Filter tweets where length exceeds 140, or at symbol count exceeds three, or hash symbol count exceeds three, ordering by tweet identifier.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT tweet_id 
FROM Tweets 
WHERE LENGTH(content) > 140 
   OR LENGTH(content) - LENGTH(REPLACE(content, '@', '')) > 3 
   OR LENGTH(content) - LENGTH(REPLACE(content, '#', '')) > 3 
ORDER BY tweet_id ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Single pass string pattern length evaluation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Not applicable; single scan with string replacement is optimal.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use string length subtraction to count character occurrences cleanly in SQL.
